titleText: Agency to implement Malta in Motion strategy to be established in 2027 – Bonett
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Agency to implement Malta in Motion strategy to be established in 2027 – Bonett. An agency dedicated to implementing the Malta in Motion strategy will be established during 2027, Sustainable Mobility Minister Chris Bonett announced, as he outlined plans to improve Malta's transport system.

titleText: Person rescued by AFM helicopter after finding themselves in difficulty at Coral Lagoon
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Person rescued by AFM helicopter after finding themselves in difficulty at Coral Lagoon. A person was rescued by an Armed Forces of Malta (AFM) helicopter on Tuesday afternoon after finding themselves in difficulty at Coral Lagoon in Mellieħa.

titleText: Mediterranean Tourism Forum aims to put residents at the centre of debate
mainText: From MaltaToday: Mediterranean Tourism Forum aims to put residents at the centre of debate. A four-day forum in Malta, organised by the Mediterranean Tourism Foundation and the Malta Hotels and Restaurants Association, has set out its focus to find out how tourism can improve daily life for residents.
